Consent does not turn harm into healthcare. We do not allow consenting adults to buy organs on the open market. We do not allow consenting adults to consent to assisted mutilation for a psychological struggle. We ban such things because we recognize that the body is not just raw material for us to carve up according to our distress. The body has a meaning, a given integrity, that we must respect.

Second, because this is not truly about private adults in private clinics. What is permitted for adults becomes promoted to everyone. You cannot create a massive, multibillion-dollar industry of hormones, puberty blockers, and surgical centers for adults and then pretend you can keep it away from teenagers. You cannot say as a society that a man can become a woman and a woman can become a man through surgery, and then tell children that it isn't true for them, too. Adult consent has become the engine that drives childhood confusion. As long as we legalize it for anyone, we normalize it for everyone. If we want to protect children, we must be consistent about truth for adults as well.

We have seen the consequences already. Young people left infertile, without sexual function, with lifelong medical complications, with deep regret for decisions they were told were irreversible but necessary. Adults who were sold a dream that a scalpel could solve their pain, only to find the pain remained, and now their body can never go back. You are a man or you are a woman, and that is good, and we will help you learn to live at peace with that reality, not flee from it.

We must ban these procedures not out of hate for anyone - but out of love. Out of love for the young woman who believes she must remove her breasts to be loved. Out of love for the young man told that happiness is on the other side of castration. Out of love for the principle that every human being is created whole and worthy, not as a project to be reconstructed.

Opponents will call this extreme. What is extreme is a system that injects healthy people with cross-sex hormones for life, that removes healthy uteruses and penises, and calls it progress. What is extreme is to keep doing that when we see the damage it leaves behind.

We need a law, plain and simple. No gender transition hormones. No gender transition surgeries. No puberty blockers for the purpose of transition. For no one. At no age. In no clinic in this country.

Let us restore medicine to its proper purpose: to heal the body, not to erase it. Let us restore law to its proper purpose: to protect human dignity even when human beings are confused about that dignity.

And let us restore our culture to a simple truth that every child has known since the beginning of time: You are fearfully and wonderfully made, as you are.
